label: Bible Study
prompt: But when thou doest alms, let not thy _____ hand know what thy right hand doeth:
verse: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
note: Giving in secret — so quietly that even your other hand doesn't hear about it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us _____ from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
verse: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
note: Paul tells a crowd in Lystra that rain, harvests, and full bellies are God's calling cards.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the _____ of righteousness;
verse: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
note: The armour of God: truth as the belt, righteousness as the breastplate — a Sunday school costume with a point.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an _____? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?
verse: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?
note: God asks Job if he can land leviathan on a fishing line — creation contains things only its Maker can handle.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in _____ of me.
verse: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.
note: The Lord's Supper words, as Paul received and passed them on: 'this do in remembrance of me.'
